# KaTeX 0.16.22

MIT license: see LICENSE in this directory.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/0.16.22
The npm archive's SHA-512 integrity was verified before copying files.

Included: dist/katex.mjs, dist/katex.min.css, dist/fonts/*.woff2 and LICENSE.
The stylesheet keeps the WOFF2 sources; unused WOFF/TTF fallbacks were removed.
No package installation, build step or CDN request is required at runtime.

Application formatting and security limits are configured in ../../format.mjs.
